decisive_items: Papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores that are lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium
Shows mucin-containing goblet cells. Neither cytologic atypia nor atypical mitotic figures are present
response.rationale: The presence of papillary fronds with nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium and mucin-containing goblet cells is more characteristic of inverted papilloma than squamous cell papilloma or verrucous carcinoma.

rejected.why: Lack of cytologic atypia or atypical mitotic figures makes verrucous carcinoma less likely.
